VIII., 8 and Mallinâth's commentary rend-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "ers it by मन्यमानः. This Stanza is given in the Kâvyasangraha p.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "40.—Vasantatilakâ.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXX.—Comp. St. 27. For the story see Râmâyaṇa re-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 2, "text": "ferred to in the note to St. 35. See also Matsya Purâṇa CCI.,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "1-4 and 21-22.—Upajâti.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXI.—मनस्वी = strong-minded. कार्यार्थी = bent on business.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "—S'ikhariṇî.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r6", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXII.—सर्वेषाम् = of all persons, or of all conditions of", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "life. This alternative meaning is suggested as the text has once", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "ऐश्वर्य and at another time प्रभवितृ. सर्वकारण = cause of all i. e. सुजनता", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "and such other “ornaments.” Râmarshi has ऐश्वर्यादीनाम् for both", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "सर्व. शील = शुद्धचरित Amara Nâṭyavarga 26. See below St. CIX. and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "Misc. St. XIX.—S'ârdûlavikrîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r7", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXIII.—यदि वा has no conditional sense, it is equivalent", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "to अथवा. For पदम् see Siddh. Kaum. I., 268. धियं बुद्धिमरीरयन्ति विचारेण", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "सर्वतः प्रवर्तयन्ति ते धीराः Râmarshi.—Vasantatilakâ.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r8", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXIV.—करण्ड is the box in which the snake charmer", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "keeps his snakes. This Stanza inculcates fatalism pure and simple,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "and it is not easy to understand why this is included among the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "Stanzas of धैर्यप्रशंसा by the arrangers of the work.—S'ârdûlavi-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 5, "text": "krîḍita.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r9", "type": "stanza_note", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "St. LXXXV.—There is a play on the word वृत्त here. It means", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "round as well as conduct, and साधुवृत्त as applied to the ball", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "means well rounded, perfectly circular. Such a ball of course re-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "bounds best. I see that Râmarshi gives the same explanation.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "—Anushṭub.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r1", "type": "page_number", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "22", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r2", "type": "running_header", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "NOTES.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}], "units": [{"id": "u1", "type": "notes", "number": null, "label": "Notes", "open_start": true, "open_end": true, "children": ["u2", "u3", "u4", "u5", "u6", "u7", "u8"]}, {"id": "u2", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "79", "label": "St. LXXIX.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r3"]}, {"id": "u3", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "80", "label": "St. LXXX.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r4"]}, {"id": "u4", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "81", "label": "St. LXXXI.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r5"]}, {"id": "u5", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "82", "label": "St. LXXXII.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r6"]}, {"id": "u6", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "83", "label": "St. LXXXIII.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r7"]}, {"id": "u7", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "84", "label": "St. LXXXIV.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r8"]}, {"id": "u8", "type": "stanza_note", "number": "85", "label": "St. LXXXV.", "open_start": false, "open_end": false, "children": ["r9"]}], "flows": [{"flow": "main", "units": ["u1"]}], "relations": []}
